_comment: Curated map of common tools to known MCP servers. The mcp-scout reads this first, then falls back to a web search. Verify package names/URLs before adding — this is a starting point, not gospel. Add project-specific entries as you discover them. Secrets are ALWAYS env-var references, never literals.

_schema.aliases: list of names/keywords that should match this tool
_schema.config: the object to place under mcpServers.<name> in .mcp.json
_schema.env: environment variables the user must set (referenced as ${VAR} in config)
_schema.scope_hint: project | user — where it usually belongs

filesystem.purpose: Read/write files in explicitly allowed directories.
filesystem.security: Pass only the directories Claude needs. Never pass '/' or your home directory.

github.purpose: Read/manage GitHub repos, issues, and PRs.
github.security: Use a fine-grained PAT. Grant repo:read only unless Claude must push.

postgres.purpose: Inspect schema and run queries against Postgres.
postgres.security: Connect with a READ-ONLY database user unless writes are required.

sqlite.purpose: Query a local SQLite database file.
sqlite.security: Point only at the intended .db file.

playwright.purpose: Drive a real browser for testing and scraping.
playwright.security: Browser automation can reach any URL — review targets in automated flows.

sentry.purpose: Read Sentry issues and error events.
sentry.security: OAuth on first connect; no static secret in the file.

notion.security: OAuth on first connect; token stored in user state, not the repo.

stripe.security: Use a RESTRICTED/read-only key. Never a live secret key with full scope.

context7.purpose: Pull current, version-accurate library documentation into context.

fetch.purpose: Fetch and convert web pages to text.
fetch.security: Can reach arbitrary URLs; be mindful of SSRF in automated flows.

supabase.purpose: Manage a Supabase project (DB, auth, storage).
supabase.security: Keep the --read-only flag unless writes are required; pin the version.
